entities.summary: First Chimurenga (Ndebele-Shona Uprising), a transformative movement in Zimbabwe (1896–1897). Emerged from Matabeleland and Pioneer Column and BSAC Rule. Catalyzed Land Apportionment Act and Self-Governing Colony.
